---
AC-008 currently reads: "ARCHITECTURE.md §12's example workflow's build job step references only field names that exist on PlatformTarget's actual camelCase JSON serialization (triple, platform, arch, abi, hostRunner, useCross, artifactName, packageDir, packageName) -- specifically, it does not reference matrix.os, matrix.package, or matrix.target (none of which are real fields), and its `runs-on:` uses `${{ matrix.hostRunner }}`."

What the spec says: the example must use a bare `${{ matrix.hostRunner }}` form and must NOT reference `matrix.target` at all.

What the system actually does (verified by reading the file directly): the implemented ARCHITECTURE.md example (DOC-1, committed) uses `strategy: matrix: target: ${{ fromJson(needs.matrix.outputs.nativeMatrix) }}` with `runs-on: ${{ matrix.target.hostRunner }}` and three other `matrix.target.<field>` dereferences (`.triple`, `.artifactName`, `.packageDir`). This is the namespaced GitHub Actions matrix form: `strategy.matrix.<key>` (here `target`) holds each array element, so its fields must be accessed as `matrix.target.<field>`, not bare `matrix.<field>`.

Crucially, this exact `matrix: target: ${{ fromJson(...) }}` / `matrix.target.<field>` pattern is not something the implementer invented -- it is the ALREADY-EXISTING, ALREADY-DOCUMENTED consumer pattern published in this same spec family at /Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/.claude/specs/callisto-matrix.md lines 287-289 (section 6.1, "consumer workflows pipe this into a downstream build job"), which SPEC-002's own AC-010 cites as the canonical consumption pattern nativeMatrix consumers should follow. AC-008 as currently written would force ARCHITECTURE.md's example to use a DIFFERENT, inconsistent matrix shape (bare `matrix.hostRunner`, which is not even valid GitHub Actions syntax for a `matrix: target: [...]` strategy -- bare matrix.<field> only works with `strategy.matrix.include: [...]`, a different form not used elsewhere in this codebase) than callisto-matrix.md §6.1 documents for the exact same nativeMatrix array. That would leave two of this project's own docs showing two different, mutually-incompatible ways to consume the same JSON shape.

Revise AC-008 so it requires the namespaced `matrix.<key>.<field>` form (matching §6.1's own precedent and forbidding only the actually-nonexistent bare `matrix.os`, `matrix.package`, or bare `matrix.target` used as a plain value rather than as a namespace prefix) rather than requiring a bare `matrix.hostRunner` form that would contradict the project's own already-published convention. Also check whether any criterion that depends on AC-008 (e.g. AC-009, which describes the same example workflow) needs a matching adjustment for consistency -- read them and decide, don't assume none do.
---

```
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.target.hostRunner }}

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact
        with:
          name: ${{ matrix.target.artifactName }}
          path: ${{ matrix.target.packageDir }}/*.node
```

And callisto-matrix.md §6.1 (lines 260-289) documents this exact `strategy: matrix: target: ${{ fromJson(...) }}` / `matrix.target.<field>` pattern as the canonical nativeMatrix consumption pattern, which SPEC-002's AC-010 already cites.

Revise them if needed, or leave them unchanged if they are already consistent -- state your reasoning either way.
